mechanism: Methylprednisolone may increase propylthiouracil metabolism via CYP450 induction and glucuronidation, potentially reducing antithyroid efficacy; corticosteroids also have immunosuppressive effects that may complicate thyroid autoimmune disease management.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4) closely; may require propylthiouracil dose adjustment; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose.
